body: Worker lesson (Sol-1cee, full gate test-f861b3bd on49742ec6, Fable2#1351/Opus2#125): a new Rust test file must respect tests::persist::tests_must_join_persist_worker_instead_of_disconnecting_its_sender. Add that exact guard filter to the focused run whenever adding test files (Fable2 direction). Never replace persist_tx to disconnect a real writer: call state.shutdown_persist_blocking() first, which joins it and fences final state. To exercise synchronous failure, shutdown before cloning/changing the fixture persistence path; no sender replacement needed. To install a fake ACK receiver, join the real worker first; after the test operation joins, drop the fake receiver for synchronous fallback. Do not evade or modify the source-tree guard. In this incident341 focused tests and two clean source reviews missed that guard; the full gate was RED7216/1 and remains preserved until task closure. A later pass validates a specific lifecycle fix, not a blind retry.
